lines.text: And Scoop is courtside with the notebook, the stat sheet, and a very long list of rematches people owe each other!
Scoop here on the second mic! Five courts on the tour, and I never get tired of that welcome.
Front row, I see you! Louder than that, come on!
Shout out to Noodle up top, never misses a run!
Fun fact from the notebook: somebody in these stands still owes me a rematch in checkers.
I've been keeping stats since I was a kid. Mostly on who hogs the snacks.
Notebook rule one: write it down before the argument starts.
Best part of any run? The argument afterward about who got fouled.
My notebook has a whole page titled Excuses. Longest page in the book.
Quick reminder: tie those laces and never trust a pump fake.
Told you! I circled this one early.
I need a bigger notebook for this!
Notebook says cold streaks don't last!
Put that on a shirt! I'm printing them now, and I'm first in line.
Congratulations, champ! Going in the notebook in ink, not pencil.
You're top of the rematch list now. Come back and cross it off!
Hey, every regular on this tour dropped a few before they ran things. Next time!
